I replied to Tobias in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

On 3 Sep 2025, Priyanka posted in that channel that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4 while label printing was stalled. When the outage was resolved, she said Southgate had cleared the backlog. Nobody in the channel gave a street address for the site, so if he needs one before the call, he'll have to get it somewhere else.
